name: Eyes of the Kami
body:
School divination [void]; Level psychic 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

Casting Time 1 full-round action

Components V, S, DF

Range personal

Area of Effect 300 ft. radius centered on you

Duration concentration, up to 1 round/level

Void: Spells with this descriptor are tied with a philosophical school of magic based on a concept known as the Void. The school teaches that the Void is the nothingness from which springs forth creativity, insight, spirit, thought, and also the source of pure energy from which all elements and phenomena are derived. Channeling the power of the Void (or the Void element) allows for the manipulation of the elements in objects and creatures, among other possibilities. Spells with the void descriptor are considered to belong to the Void element (for geomancers) and the void elemental school (for void elementalists).

If a spell has the [void] descriptor, it cannot be dispelled by elements release regardless of how high is your CL.

Reaching out through the Void, you are connected to all the spirits and elements in the area of effect (including objects and creatures), granting you the all-round vision universal monster ability and allowing you to perceive simultaneously from every position within range. You also cannot be caught by surprise.

Additionally, you may observe any object or creature within the area from any angle or range but only if it does not require the movement of the object or creature in some way. You can, for example, do the following:

Observe a closed chest from the outside but not see the contents inside the closed chest.
Read the pages that a distant book was opened at but not the rest of the book as that would require turning the pages.
See on the other side of a wall, door, or ceiling but not within them (you would not automatically detect secret compartments).

However, you are limited to viewing to the maximum range of eyes of the kami since any obstruction would normally limit your line of sight. You may only use your visual senses with this spell; it does not have any effect on the illumination conditions within the area of effect with respect to you. For example, if the area is dark and if you do not have darkvision (or similar visual sense), you cannot see within the area.

Because this spell connects you to the spirits and elements within objects and creatures, this spell is only blocked by barriers made of materials that are harmful to spirits (such as cold iron for fey) or summoned by magic (such as wall spells with solid walls).

If you fail to make a concentration check to maintain concentration on this spell, you are also dazed for one round.
